profile.name: Selling Vigilance
profile.description: Turns shop-floor photos and spoken details into a priced inventory with IDs, photo cards, and a print-ready PDF — plus daytime auto-backups so nothing gets lost mid-catalog.

memory.content: Final printout format: print-ready PDF with item IDs (E-01… equipment, model-prefixed for parts) and each photo on the same page as name, qty, price, and notes.
User is building a parts inventory for several gun models; will upload a photo then verbally give model number, part type, and quantity, to be organized by model number.
Inventory includes Equipment (shop machines) as well as parts organized by gun model number. File equipment under an equipment folder and model parts under a models folder by model.
Inventory final deliverable will be a print-ready PDF with numbered items (E-01… for equipment, model-prefixed for models) and each photo on the same page as name/qty/price/notes.
For museum-gun inventory descriptions, use the user's verbiage framing them as very high-value unique pieces that make the sale of the company easier; somebody's gonna want these guns.
